note: Old 13-joint rig (src/player.js createPlayer) -> new 22-bone rig. 'bones' spreads a rotation written to the old joint; 'read' is the bone that stands for the old joint. This table maps BY POSITION: old index 0 is the limb at x<0.

sides.evidence: Checked 2026-09-26 in the browser on main e40fa61: createPlayer() at yaw 0 faces +z (boot toe at z=+0.196 from the ankle; gameplay forward is (sin yaw, cos yaw)); legs[0] hip at x=-0.09, arms[0] at x=-0.209. Facing +z, -x is the player's RIGHT. New rig: LeftUpLeg at +x after glTF export (checked by 01_body.py).
sides.convention: After PR #34 (fix/left-right): 'left' means the player's left everywhere. src/sides.js has RIGHT=0, LEFT=1 and sideIndex(foot); every foot->index conversion in motion.js, foot-plant.js and skills.js goes through it, and contact-model.js footSign('left') is +1. This table therefore maps legs0/arms0 -> Right* and legs1/arms1 -> Left* with no further flips when the new body is connected.
sides.before_fix: Until PR #34 the game mirrored both sides consistently: footSign('left')=-1 put the logical left foot on the player's right and 13 sites mapped 'left'->0 (the right leg). A left-footed player was drawn kicking with the right leg. The kick pose and CMU 10_01 are authored on legs[1] (left) and mirrored for the other foot.
sides.requires: Connect the new body only on top of PR #34, otherwise left/right are mirrored.
